payload.evidence: We have changed how we refer to rent arrears caused by financial abuse, to ensure survivors are not unfairly prevented from joining the housing register when they need support.
payload.explanation: The council says in its own “you said, we did” update that the consultation changed this, so the link is the council's rather than ours. One line in the adopted scheme matches: the exception for rent arrears widened from “a person is fleeing violence” to “a person is fleeing violence or domestic abuse”. The council does not say that is the line it means, and its words are “financial abuse” rather than domestic abuse, so we cannot put it beyond doubt — but it is the only rent-arrears wording that moved between the two versions.
